systems.system: fichier national et réseau informatique de la direction de l'identification civile
systems.country_label: carte nationale d'identité informatisée, sécurisée et biométrique
systems.owner: direction de l'identification civile, ministère de la sécurité et de l'ordre public (police nationale)
systems.tiers: direction centrale with a central server; production centres at Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Oyo, each with a local network; departmental data-collection sections; collection antennas in arrondissements, districts and urban communities that are not district seats

note: Gazette issue of organisational texts: arrêtés 1888 and 1889 of 10 May 2022 organise the police's identity-card directorate and its own field antennas, a central body; local authorities appear only in a land law's pre-emption clause, an urban-planning project's support to mairies and nominations of commune officials. Nothing on a connection at a local government office.
